title: Brick
body:
"Why.. why would you want a singular brick?"

Description

The Brick is a special item bought in Flora Laura for $15. It is located in the wall in the right side room near the stairs.

Trivia

  • The brick can be used as a building material, one brick can fill up to 60 cubic studs, E.g. a 1x6x10 cube (See fig. 1 for example).
  • The brick can be painted as of v1.63.0.
  • The brick can be dyed using a Dye Machine.
  • A similar brick can be seen in the lighthouse in white, but cannot be bought.

Building Tips

  • Bricks used in a cube schematic interlock with each other. (fig. 1)
  • Bricks used in the Rotated Bricks schematic are a bit off, as they are not large enough to entirely fill each of the schematic's bricks. (fig. 2)
  • Bricks used in the Small Rotated Bricks schematic perfectly fit each of the schematic's bricks. (fig. 2)
